$comment: Single source of truth for the agent-writable UI settings. Consumed by src-tauri/src/commands/settings_schema.rs (CLI validation, `vibe99ctl settings schema`, and settings sanitization) and cross-checked against the zod schema in src/domain/settings-schema.ts by src/domain/settings-fields.test.ts.

fontFamily.description: Font family name. Empty string uses the platform default

paneMaskOpacity.description: Mask overlay opacity for inactive panes (0.0-1.0, 0 = transparent)

paneWidth.description: Default pane width in pixels, rounded to the nearest 10

webglEnabled.description: Enable the WebGL terminal renderer (takes effect after restart)

activityAlertDebounceMs.description: Idle debounce before a pane is flagged as having background activity (ms)

layoutHotkeys.description: Global shortcut per layout id, e.g. {"layout-1": "F1"}

quakeLayouts.description: Per-layout quake-mode config keyed by layout id, e.g. {"layout-1": {"position": "top", "height": 60}}. Presence of a layout id enables quake for that layout
